{
  "project": "agentic-knowledge-mapper",
  "what_building": "A risk assessment engine that evaluates the security and operational risks of multi-agent LLM systems and specific model deployments. It generates structured risk registers by mapping potential misuse scenarios, CVEs, and failure modes like sycophancy or prompt injection.",
  "pipeline": [
    "make_brief",
    "score_product_risk",
    "score_model_risk",
    "map_attacks(CVE)",
    "emit_register"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "brief",
    "product",
    "model_desc",
    "exposure tier",
    "subject profile"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "risk register",
    "exposure tier score (0-100)",
    "CVE/attack mapping",
    "residual risk assessment"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "heuristic guess: multi-agent debate risk scorer :: brief/product/model descriptors -> risk-scoring prompts (tiers 0-100, CVE/attack mapping) -> risk register",
    "Title: Risks and failure modes of multi-agent debate systems",
    "Use: what adversarial scenarios could an attacker engineer with this model for credit scoring of tabular records",
    "schema hints: ['brief', 'exposure tier', 'knowledge graph', 'misuse potential', 'model risk', 'residual risk', 'schema']"
  ]
}
